title: Hacked Hardware Can Force AI Chatbots to Give Dangerous Answers
summary: Vulnerabilities in the physical components of large-scale AI systems allow attackers to influence the output of chatbot interfaces. New research shared with CNN found that when the hardware underpinning these models is compromised, the resulting AI responses can be manipulated to provide incorrect or harmful information to users.
